jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

About The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.

 What To Expect?

  • You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus. 
    • Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities. 
    • Our Application Foundations group includes design systems & information architecture, as well as workflows & automation tooling, and search & discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36. 
    • The Business Foundations group focuses on identity & access, monetization, and platform insights. 
  • You'll manage a team of designers you can genuinely invest in — coaching career growth, shaping how they work, and giving them real ownership over their piece of the platform.
  • You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership on strategy, not just execution to shape how Optimization, Application Foundations, and Business Foundations evolve.
  • You'll help define what AI-native design leadership looks like at Contentful, at a moment when the company is actively maturing that muscle. The Contentful platform includes AI powered customer facing features, and accordingly, we progressively evolve our design tooling and ways of working to take advantage of emerging technologies. 
  • You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally. 
  • Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly. 
  • You will be joining at a pivotal moment: Contentful's recent acquisition by Salesforce puts this team's work in front of a massive new customer base, giving you a rare chance to help shape design at a large scale. 

What You Need To Be Successful

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product designers, ideally at a B2B SaaS or platform company.
  • Strong track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership at the strategy level, not just translating requirements. You will influence roadmap decisions, represent design's perspective in cross-functional planning, and drive visioning initiatives.

  • A track record of design leadership that extends beyond your own team. Experience shaping and evolving the product design function’s practices within an organization. 
  • Maintain a high bar for design craft, with a portfolio reflecting strong interaction and visual design fundamentals. You set and uphold that same bar across your team by giving specific, actionable feedback that sharpens execution, not just strategy.
  • A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform. 
  • Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.
  • Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams. 
  • A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.
  • Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).
 Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.
 This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.
 You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!
 
 About hyperexponential (hx) 
 At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 
 About the team 
 Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.
 As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.
 The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.
 Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!
 
 What you'll be doing 
 Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.
 Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.
 Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.
 Become the developer

jobs.title: Product Growth Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an ambitious PM ready to build Nelly's Growth function from scratch - owning the full journey from sign-up to habit across our software, AI, and fintech surfaces, with direct impact on NRR. If you want real ownership and zero hand-holding, this is it.
  
 About Nelly 
 We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.
 Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.
 What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.
 
 Joining us, you will: 
 Translate Nelly's company vision into specific, prioritized bets across acquisition, activation, and monetisation, informed by data, experimentation, and customer behavior

 Own the end-to-end user journey: from partial sign-up through setup, first value, and habit formation - across Nelly's software, AI, and fintech products, and continuously sharpen each stage

 Build platform-level growth capabilities that compound across surfaces , not features that live in one place

 Design and run a rigorous experimentation and measurement program. Form hypotheses, define metrics, ship A/B tests at high velocity, learn fast, and ship what moves the numbers

 Collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Leadership on both strategy and execution

 Inform pricing, packaging, and self-serve strategy in partnership with GTM and finance leadership - including how we package across software, AI, and fintech to drive expansion (vertical & geo)
 

 What you'll bring: 
 Note: If you don't meet all the criteria, we still encourage you to apply and make the case for why you'd be a great fit. If you're exceptional talent, we're happy to adapt. 
 Shipped exceptional B2B/prosumer growth products in high-velocity environments - you care deeply about user outcomes and winning with the product

 3+ years in product management with hands-on PLG (and ideally PLS) experience: you've built and owned elaborated growth motions on complex B2B workflow products

 High agency and high learning velocity: you run a high volume of hypothesis-driven bets, move fast in ambiguity, say "no" when needed, and are comfortable building from zero

 Strong analytical skills and data mindset around A/B testing, optimization, and defining growth metrics

 Strong data mindset: you create data acquisition and evaluation strategies, track product and agent metrics (utilization rates, precision & recall), understand online vs. offline eval trade-offs, and use insights to drive better customer outcomes

 Passion for AI technology and its potential to reshape product-led growth

 Excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success
 

 Even better if you have: 
 German or Italian proficiency - you can discuss real work with dentists, ZFAs/ZMVs, and billing partners

 Experience growing products for SMB customers in less-digital European verticals (healthcare, construction, legal, architecture, or similar) where adoption is hard-won and not a given

 Experience with self-serve, freemium, or PQL-driven growth motions

 Experience with high-growth SaaS products using usage or outcome-based pricing, where you owned strategies to drive net revenue retention (NRR) growth
 

 What we offer: 
 Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or a Swapfiets membership to cruise through the city

 Urban Sports membership to sweat, stretch, or sauna your way through the week

 Top of the line working equipment

 Flexible hours and a hybrid setup in the heart of Berlin

 Enjoy up to 4 weeks of workation wherever inspiration hits

 A cozy, dog-friendly office where good vibes are basically mandatory

 A fridge full of cold drinks and snacks waiting to be claimed

 
 We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the req

We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

This role owns product marketing for the latter two — together the backbone of RobCo's current business. Embedded Robotics is our single largest source of net-new revenue today; Integrated Solutions is our large-deal, high-touch offering, often but not exclusively delivered together with partners.
 This is a depth role. You'll get genuinely close to customers and verticals - automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and more - and turn that understanding into the content and enablement material that helps Sales (and our partners) actually close. RobCo already has a growing library of real deployments with measurable results; a large part of this role is turning that raw material into whitepapers, case studies, and video content people actually use.
 Longer term, you'll help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY - the network of engaged customers and champions we're building across Embedded and Integrated. Finding and nurturing the customers willing to go public with their story is as much a part of this role as writing the story itself.
 Your Responsibilities 
 1. Sales Enablement for Embedded Robotics & Integrated Solutions 
 Own enablement materials — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — for both streams.

 Integrated Solutions skews heavily toward partner-led deals — build materials that equip our partner network, not just our direct sellers.

 2. Customer & Vertical Understanding 
 Build and maintain vertical-specific messaging and use-case libraries — automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and beyond.

 Talk regularly to customers, Sales, and Solutions Engineering so messaging stays grounded in what's actually being deployed, not just what's on the roadmap.

 3. Content Creation, at Volume 
 Own whitepapers, case studies, and video content end-to-end — turning real deployments into content Sales can actually use in a deal.

 Keep the case study and reference library current as new proof points land — this is a living library, not a one-time project.

 4. RobCoMMUNITY (Long-Term) 
 Help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY across our customer landscape.

 Identify and nurture reference customers willing to go public - case studies, testimonials, events.

 We're Looking For Someone Who Has 
 3–5 years in Product Marketing, Content Marketing, or Customer Marketing - B2B; industrial or technical experience is a strong plus.

 Strong, proven writing skills - comfortable owning a whitepaper or case study from a rough customer conversation through to a finished, polished piece.

 Genuine curiosity about customers - comfortable interviewing a customer and turning their story into content that sells.

 Organized to keep a growing content library current - this role is as much about maintenance as creation.

 Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

 Experience in industrial, manufacturing, robotics, or adjacent B2B tech.

 Experience supporting sales motions.

 Video content coordination experience.

 Familiarity with content workflows.

 The category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics is being defined right now, and our partner ecosystem is one of the key levers for how we scale across Europe and into the US. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Robotics & Safety

 As our Principal Product Manager – Robotics & Safety (m/f/d), you own the long-term product vision across RobCo's software, AI, and hardware capabilities. You bridge the digital and physical, ensuring smart, modular, and safe automation across our product portfolio.
 Your Responsibilities 
 Define the product vision – Own and shape the long-term roadmap for RobCo's software, AI, and hardware capabilities, setting strategic direction for smart, modular, and safe automation across the product portfolio.

 Bridge digital and physical – Drive seamless integration between software intelligence and mechanical systems at an organizational level, ensuring a cohesive, high-performance, and safe experience across multiple product lines.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation

 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

 
Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

 What You'll Do 

 Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.

 Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.

 Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.

 Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.

 Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.

 Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.

 Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

 Who You Are 
 

 You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).

 You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.

 You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.

 You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.

 You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.

 You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.

 You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.

 You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.

 You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.

 You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.

 Where You'll Be 

 This role is based in London or Stockholm.

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
  
 Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.
  
 To do so, here are your responsibilities:
  
 OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP 
 Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

 Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

 Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

  
 SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE 
 Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

 Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

 Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

  
 MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT 
 Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

 Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

 Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

 Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

  
 REQUIREMENTS
  
 Must-haves
 Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

 Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

 Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

 Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

 Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

 Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

  
 Nice-to-haves
 Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

 Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

 Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

This position is based in Berlin/Munich, Germany. 

 

The Trust Platform team builds the capabilities that bring identity and fraud prevention signals together into configurable customer journeys. It gives customers a consistent way to orchestrate signals, configure decision logic, and access outcomes through APIs and a studio. By connecting IDnow products, external providers, and customer needs, the team turns a broad platform ecosystem into clear, scalable solutions. Its work strengthens IDnow’s ability to help businesses make trusted decisions throughout the customer journey. 

 

As (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Modules (f/m/d), you own the product direction for platform capabilities that extend the Trust Platform’s orchestration model, studio, APIs, dashboard, and data layer. You work at the intersection of market and commercial functions, customers, vendors, other IDnow product teams, Engineering, Data, Design, and Analytics. This is the most strategic and market-facing product role in the team, with responsibility for anticipating customer needs and translating them into coherent platform capabilities.  

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • You are very close to our customers and work closely with Sales, Solutions, Marketing, and other commercial functions to assess market needs, anticipate customer problems, and proactively identify viable use cases 
  • Lead the end-to-end integration lifecycle for non-IDnow signals, including biometrics, device fingerprinting, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and sanctions screening, document databases, and credit bureaus, across the orchestration model, studio, and application programming interfaces (APIs) 
  • Conduct commercial and technical evaluations of vendors and lead requests for proposal (RFP) processes to ensure the Trust Platform offers state-of-the-art tools and capabilities 
  • Act as the product counterpart to other IDnow product teams, own the integration of their products into the Trust Platform, and manage cross-functional dependencies 
  • Own the dashboards and analytics features within the Trust Platform dashboard, providing customers with meaningful real-time data on conversion, drop-offs, and fraud

jobs.title: Functional Consultant & Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.
  
 About the role
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
  
 What you'll do
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

  
 What you'll bring
 Key attributes for success 
 Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

  
 What you'll get
 High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth. Fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership. Be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
 Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.
 
 Deine Aufgaben
 Du verantwortest strategische und operative Product-Marketing-Initiativen 

 Du analysierst Zielgruppen, Kundenbedürfnisse und Markttrends, leitest daraus relevante Insights ab und entwickelst daraus klare Produktpositionierungen, Messaging und Marketingstrategien.

 Du arbeitest eng mit dem Managementteam sowie Product, Marketing, Sales und weiteren relevanten Teams zusammen und unterstützt bei strategischen Entscheidungen rund um Produkt- und Wachstumsinitiativen.

 Du identifizierst eigenständig Potenziale für neue Marketing- und Growth-Projekte, entwickelst datenbasierte Strategien und setzt diese kundenorientiert sowie unternehmerisch von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung um.

 Du entwickelst und optimierst kontinuierlich Marketingmaterialien, Kampagnen, Landingpages, Sales Enablement Assets und weitere Touchpoints entlang der Customer Journey.

 Du analysierst die Performance unserer Product-Marketing-Maßnahmen, leitest konkrete Optimierungspotenziale ab und testest neue Ansätze, Kanäle und Botschaften.

 Du übernimmst eigenständig strategische und operative Projekte, treibst diese von Start bis Ende voran und sorgst für eine messbare Wirkung auf Wachstum, Produktnutzung und Kundenzufriedenheit.

 Du übernimmst Ad-hoc-Projekte in unterschiedlichen Bereichen des Marketings und bringst deine Expertise und dein unternehmerisches Denken dort ein, wo gerade die größten Chancen liegen.

  
 Dein Profil 
 Du hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School

 Du verfügst über erste Arbeitserfahrung oder Praktika in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting

 Du bist kreativ und es fällt dir leicht andere Menschen zu überzeugen

 Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus

 Du besitzt eine natürliche Stärke in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern

 Du hast großes Interesse am Aufbau von Unternehmen und einen ausgeprägten Willen Neues zu lernen

 Du hast eine zielstrebige Arbeitsweise, ein hohes Maß an Proaktivität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

 Du besitzt Erfahrung im Priorisieren von Aufgaben in einem fast-paced Environment und kannst einen 100%-Ansatz beim Arbeiten an wichtigen Aufgaben umsetzen

 Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an Dich selbst und andere und legst eine Can-Do-Mentalität an den Tag die andere motiviert

 Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift

  
 Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️
  
 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen 
 Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

 Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

 Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

 Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

 Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

 Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

 Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

 Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

jobs.title: Data Product Manager - Core Data Product (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Core Data Product, au sein du Data CoE (centre d'expertise data), recherche un·e Data Product Manager à Paris

DECATHLON accélère sa transformation pour devenir LA plateforme numérique sportive mondiale. Le digital et l’IA sont les moteurs de notre ambition 2026-2030 pour rendre le sport durablement accessible. Au cœur de cette stratégie, la donnée est notre actif le plus critique. Notre défi ? La rendre accessible, de confiance et actionnable afin de pouvoir la mettre à disposition du business et de la stratégie

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Tu seras responsable de définir la vision et la feuille de roadmap d'un produit Data, en encadrant indirectement une équipe de data engineers. Ta mission sera de rendre la donnée facile d'accès et de confiance afin d'accompagner le business à prendre des décisions orientées data!

Tes missions principales :

  1. Stratégie et Vision du Produit Data
    Définition de la Roadmap : Concevoir et piloter la feuille de route des produits de données (algorithmes, tableaux de bord, API de données, plateformes d'IA).

Alignement Business : S'assurer que les initiatives data répondent aux objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise (ex: réduction du churn via le machine learning, optimisation des prix, etc.).

Identification des opportunités : Détecter les cas d'usage où la donnée peut créer un avantage concurrentiel ou améliorer l'efficacité interne.

  1. Gestion du Cycle de Vie de la Donnée
    Collecte et Infrastructure : Collaborer avec les Data Engineers pour s'assurer que les pipelines de données sont robustes et que les sources sont fiables.

Gouvernance et Qualité : Garantir que les données sont propres, cohérentes et conformes aux réglementations (RGPD). Il est le garant de la "vérité" des données diffusées.

Démocratisation : Rendre la donnée accessible et compréhensible pour les utilisateurs non techniques à travers l'organisation.

  1. Collaboration Transverse
    Interface Technique : Traduire les besoins business en spécifications techniques pour les Data Scientists et Data Engineers.

Accompagnement des Stakeholders : Éduquer les décideurs (Marketing, Ventes, Direction) sur le potentiel et les limites de la data.

Agilité : Piloter le développement des modèles de données en mode agile (sprints, tests A/B, itérations rapides).

  1. Analyse et Mesure de la Performance
    Définition des KPI : Établir les indicateurs de succès non seulement pour le produit final, mais aussi pour la performance des modèles (précision, rappel, temps de latence des données).

Analyse d'impact : Mesurer concrètement le retour sur investissement (ROI) des projets data mis en place.

  1. Éthique et Sécurité
    Éthique de l'IA : Veiller à ce que les algorithmes développés ne soient pas biaisés et respectent l'éthique de l'entreprise.

Sécurité : S'assurer que l'accès aux données sensibles est sécurisé et contrôlé.

COMPETENCE TECHNIQUE

Data Product Strategy & Management
Data Governance & Compliance
Business Modeling
Data Architecture
Agile Methodologies
Backlog Management
SQL, Python (for data validation & automation)
Visualization Tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc.)
AI/ML Integration and ability to manage predictive models.
Data Governance frameworks and compliance knowledge (GDPR, CCPA).
Real-Time Data Integration (APIs, Kafka, Streaming).
Data Modeling, Business Intelligence Tools (Tableau, Power BI).
SQL, Python, and familiarity with data platforms like Databricks and Snowflake.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

Tes dernières expériences t’ont permis de développer un intérêt majeur pour les problématiques liées au cloud et à la donnée, tout en consolidant tes connaissances en cycle de vie produit (PLM).

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Product Management dans un contexte international et technique.
  • User-centric : Tu maîtrises le Design Thinking et sais traduire des besoins métiers complexes en parcours utilisateurs fluides.
  • Impact-driven : Tu as une sensibilité forte pour l'écologie et l'éthique environnementale.
  • Analytique : Tu es à l'aise avec la donnée technique et les calculs d'impact complexes.
  • Sportif·ve : Tu es passionné·e de sport et souhaites mettre ton talent au service de sa pratique durable.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Lille.
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos eng

jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Affiliate Manager (AI Product)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Affiliate Manager (AI Product) based in Germany. 

 The Affiliate Manager will manage and scale an existing network of affiliate partners across multiple commercial models.
You will own partner onboarding, technical setup, performance monitoring, optimization, and ongoing relationship management.
The role combines commercial partnership management with hands-on expertise in tracking, attribution, analytics, and traffic quality.
You will use performance data to identify opportunities, improve underperforming placements, and support sustainable partner growth.
Working closely with Business Development, you will help launch new partnerships and ensure they are technically configured and performing effectively.
You will also maintain accurate partner and reporting infrastructure while investigating discrepancies and emerging performance issues.
This is an international, remote role suited to an analytical and technically confident professional working in a fast-moving AI product environment.

 Accountabilities: 
 
 
 Manage and scale an existing affiliate partner portfolio across CPA, RevShare, and Hybrid commercial models.

 Handle the full partner lifecycle, including onboarding, creative selection, landing page setup, tracking configuration, quality assurance, and ongoing optimization.

 Monitor daily and weekly partner KPIs, including traffic quality, conversion rates, CPA, ROI, and placement performance.

 Identify underperforming traffic and work directly with partners to implement optimization strategies and improve results.

 Maintain tracking and reporting infrastructure, including postback/S2S configurations, and investigate discrepancies between partner and internal statistics.

 Keep the affiliate partner database accurate and up to date, including contacts, commercial terms, geographic coverage, status, and next steps.

 Support Business Development with the launch and scaling of new custom partnerships once commercial terms have been established.

 Manage technical setup, initial monitoring, and early-stage optimization for newly launched partnerships.

 Monitor competitor affiliate programs and share relevant market insights and opportunities with the wider team.

 Maintain strong partner communication and ensure affiliate activities align with applicable advertising platform requirements.

 Requirements: 

 
 At least 2 years of experience in full-cycle affiliate account management, including partner onboarding, creative and landing page setup, tracking implementation, and scaling.

 Strong understanding of CPA, CPL, CPS, RevShare, and Hybrid models, as well as affiliate channel economics, traffic quality, and fraud risks.

 Technical literacy in tracking technologies, pixels, postbacks, server-to-server (S2S) tracking, attribution, and basic API usage.

 Experience managing partner pipelines, CRM systems, and affiliate databases with strong attention to data accuracy and organization.

 Analytical skills with the ability to build and interpret performance dashboards, identify anomalies, and turn data into optimization decisions.

 Understanding of advertising platform compliance requirements and best practices.

 Confident use of AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT for research, analysis, communication, and daily workflow support.

 Strong business English skills, both written and verbal, with confidence communicating with international partners and leading partner calls.

 Comfortable working independently, managing multiple partners and priorities, and taking ownership of performance outcomes.

 Strong communication, relationship-building, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.

 Benefits: 

 
 Fully remote work with the opportunity to work from anywhere.

 International environment with collaboration across multiple markets and regions.

 Opportunity to manage and scale affiliate partnerships for an AI-focused product.

 Hands-on exposure to performance marketing, attribution, tracking, and partnership growth.

 Opportunity to work with CPA, RevShare, and Hybrid affiliate models.

 Close collaboration with Business Development and other commercial teams.

 Opportunity to contribute to new partnership launches and optimization strategies.

 Initial pay level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.

 Full-time position with opportunities to develop expertise in affiliate marketing, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows.

jobs.title: Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Projekt für Dich: moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt  Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen.
Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über  100 Millionen Angeboten , vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. 

Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d) .

 Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung.
 Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt.
 Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat.
 Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein.
 Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt.
 Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live. 
 Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung.
 Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte.
 Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an.
 

 Deine Stärken Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast
 Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten
 Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini
 Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt
 Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen
 Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon
 Erfahrung mit Retrieval, Ranking oder semantischer Suche sowie mit dem Aufbau von Evals und Testsets ist wünschenswert
 Kenntnisse in Produktdaten, Feeds, Taxonomien und Attributsystemen sind von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Python sowie mit MCP- und Agenten-Anbindungen
 Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, M&A Transactions and Valuations
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating/collecting, licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured data that is both self-sourced and from third party content providers. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product management content, collection operations, and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the team and with external partners and internal stakeholders.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a Sr. Product Manager to oversee our M&A Transactions and Valuations content. Candidates should have deep knowledge of the fundamentals of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of managing 3rd party or proprietary M&A Transactions content feeding into financial research platforms and investment analysis workflow functionality. 

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience working in Product, Content, Operations, or equivalent roles at a financial institution, investment research platform, or market intelligence firm, focused on the delivery of content, features, analytics, and models for front-office investment professionals
  • 3+ years of experience managing or working closely with a globally distributed content generation operation
  • Expert knowledge of various market data and investment research databases, products, and tools (e.g.: Fundamentals, Estimates, M&A Transactions data, Ownership data, Market data, Excel plug-in, XML feeds)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a dedicated cross-functional development team of engineers, data experts, QA, scrum master
  • Thorough understanding of the logic and concepts of relational databases (eg: SQL); demonstrated experience using them is strongly preferred
  • BSc, MSc, or MBA degree with a concentration in finance or economics or a CFA certification 
  • Demonstrated passion for corporate finance, capital markets, financial analysis, and modeling demonstrated either in previous capacity in a buy-side or sell-side analyst role or have managed products/features/data used by investment professionals
  • You have a natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of data, technology, and finance
  • You thrive in a builder’s role - you have designed, built, launched and managed a marquee product, module, or functionality for the investment community or have set the foundation and successfully run an extensive content generation operation
  • You excel at aligning diverse, cross-functional teams through clear, persuasive communication and executive-level presentations
  • You demonstrate empathic communication, with the ability to listen and identify problems in need for solutions
  • You’re highly analytical, tech-savvy, and meticulous, with a strong ability to set priorities, manage deadlines, and deliver results
  • Material experience in the financial industry as a front office professional (e.g. research analyst or investment banker) leveraging platforms and and content similar to AlphaSense’s is preferred
  • Prior experience at a market intelligence or financial research SaaS start-up is preferred
  • Experience using iterative / agile development methodologies is preferred
  • Experience working with distributed teams is preferred

 Challenge estimates. You will push back on both optimistic and padded numbers, and build an estimation model the team can reuse.

 Lead distributed engineering squads across Böblingen and Lisbon without formal authority over them.

 Automate your own reporting with AI tooling, so status packs take minutes rather than half a day.

 Demonstrable ownership of budget and scope, not just timeline coordination. You can talk through a project's numbers, not only its Gantt chart.

 Enough technical depth to read an API contract, a data model, or a pull request and hold your own with senior engineers.

 Experience negotiating scope changes with client stakeholders and converting them into commercial agreements.

 German at business level (client steering committees run in German) plus fluent English (engineering work runs in English).

 Comfort in a distributed setup with colleagues in two countries.

 Nice-to-haves 
 Hands-on exposure to HubSpot CMS, HubSpot APIs, or a comparable platform ecosystem.

 Experience with AI-assisted delivery work, agent workflows, or LLM tooling in a delivery context.

 A background that started technical (development, QA, solution engineering) before moving into delivery management.

 
 Your Team

The Team Lead Development seat is currently open, so you will work directly with the Practice Lead and have unusual room to shape how software delivery runs here. You will also work closely with the PMO Practice, which owns delivery method across the company.
 
 Tech Stack 
 HubSpot (CMS, custom modules, APIs), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude and Claude Code, GitHub and GitHub Actions, MCP-based agent tooling, Miro, Figma for design handover.
 What We Offer 
 30 vacation days per year, plus Baden-Württemberg public holidays on top.

 Hybrid working from our Böblingen HQ, in a team that is genuinely used to distributed collaboration.

 Company pension plan with an employer contribution that grows with tenure, starting at 50 EUR per month.

 Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service, and free brand choice.

 Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month, usable in restaurants, supermarkets, and delivery apps.

 Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility, and insurance, free to use.

 E-scooters at the office for local trips during the working day.

 Real AI exposure. You will not read about agentic delivery in a strategy deck, you will run the projects that build it and use AI tooling in your own daily work.

 
 About Thorit 
 Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients across the DACH market, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Reference Data is part of the Data Enablement team at Addepar. Our mission is to build a scalable, efficient, and high quality data platform that integrates, connects, productionizes, and distributes third-party data content across Addepar and to our clients and partners.  

Our goal is to connect data to consumers, creating more value for our downstream clients and services, enabling data to be a language on how the Addepar ecosystem collaborates.

Data Enablement's mission is to be the platform product management function that gives Addepar's engineering and solution teams the foundational tools, APIs, and services they need to move faster — with a focus on growth, employee experience, and reducing operational risk.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and own the product roadmap for Market Data Feeds — balancing feed quality, coverage, and commercial ROI — and set measurable success criteria that hold delivery teams accountable.
  • Own feed builds end-to-end: from vendor sourcing and data modeling through to production delivery, driving outcomes that directly support client goals.
  • Develop solutions to strengthen market data operations and deepen the integration of Market and Reference Data across Addepar's products and services.
