  • Contribute to the evolution of Addepar's Security Master, directly linking Market Data inputs into expanding the richness of information delivered to client and internal product teams.
  • Work closely with GTM, Sales, and Support to communicate Market Data changes proactively and serve as a product-informed partner on dataset capabilities, feed status, and onboarding timelines.
  • Understand Addepar's products and clients deeply, using those insights to drive new opportunities that improve client experience. 

Who You Are

  • Extensive relevant work experience and education that demonstrate proficiency in product management and user workflows
  • Deep understanding and familiarity with Market Data vendors (Bloomberg, LSEG, S&P, Morningstar, etc) and how to best source and implement their content
  • Domain expertise regarding market data processing and entitlement workflows, security mastering, and financial products as well as strong knowledge of the financial data ecosystem.
  • Experience with building and launching commercial data products within financial services.  Understanding of data governance practices.
  • Ability to work cross functionally, particularly with engineering, operations, and GTM.
  • Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; creative (non-dogmatic) with project approaches, willingness to experiment, and ability to guide teams toward activities and processes that best suit project goals
  • Ability to identify the appropriate tools and techniques to accomplish objectives
  • Knowledge of SQL and ability to query data to find answers to product questions.  Experience with Python and Dat

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

 Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

 The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
 GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

 What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
 You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
 You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
 You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
 You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
 You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
 You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
 You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
 You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

 What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
 Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
 Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
 Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
 Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
 Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients
 
 What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
 Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
 Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
 AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
 Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
 You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

 Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
 Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
 Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
 Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background
 Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
 Notion fluency
 
 Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

 How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
 Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
 Interview with the PM, including a brief intro

About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
tl;dr
 After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the intelligence layer for the construction industry.

 The largest construction enterprises in Europe, with a combined project volume of over €30bn annually, rely on Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

 Construction has the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM, PDFs, drawings, 3D models, images, calculations. At Kuro you can tackle the hardest applied AI problems everyday.

 Curious about the bigger product challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build .
 

 About us
 Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.
 Kuro is the intelligent project data system for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible.
 After one year on the market leading construction enterprises with a combined construction volume >30 billion annually use Kuro everyday to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.
 We are 16 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of ex-technical founders and builders that are ambitious and kind.
 Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin 
 
 The Opportunity
 As Product Manager , you'll work on the platform at the heart of Kuro's product, building the foundational capabilities that enable our teams to deliver faster and scale with confidence. You'll help defining the strategy and execution, from the data domain model, project graphs, and ontologies to workflow abstractions and essential services such as permissions, document versioning, lineage, and collaboration.
 Working closely with the Co-Founder & CPO, platform engineering, design, and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), you'll ensure every investment accelerates the development of future use cases, making the platform more extensible, scalable, and powerful with every release.
  
 What You'll Do 
 Be an active voice in roadmap creation, balancing immediate platform needs with long-term strategic investments.

 Lead strategic initiatives to capture key decisions across the project lifecycle and evolve Kuro's scalable data domain model.

 Define success metrics, use production data to iterate on platform capabilities, and communicate releases across the organization.

 Make informed decisions on prioritization, scope, and sequencing, partnering with leadership on major architectural and new product bets.

 Discover opportunities with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements.

 
 Your profile 
 5+ years of product management experience building technical products, such as AI, automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software.

 Proven experience shipping data platform products, APIs, or graph- and ontology-based systems.

 Strong understanding of how LLM-powered products behave in production and the challenges of building AI-native products.

 Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing short-term needs with long-term platform investments.

 Passion for understanding users' day-to-day workflows and a willingness to become a domain expert in the construction industry.

 Fluent in German, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

 Bonus: 
 Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or workflow abstraction frameworks.

 Founder experience or experience building products in an early-stage startup.

 Experience in construction technology (ConTech), AEC software, or a related industry.

  
 Why Kuro 
 You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.
 Explore the technical vision behind Kuro, from processing more than one million construction pages a month to entity resolution, evidence-linked answers, and 3D project graphs. Kuro Product Vision → 
  
 The process 
 Talent Acquisition Call — Intro, logistics & fit (30 min)

 Impact Call: Deep dive with Jonas & Get to know Product (30 min)

 Challenge: A time-boxed product challenge (≤4 hours)

 Challenge review and deep dive (60 minutes)

 On-site Day — Meet the team and lunch/dinner
 Culture Interview (30 Min)

 Meet several team members

 Go for lunch with the team

 
 Decision

 Compensation: €85K – €110K • 0.05% – 0.15%

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Marketplace
jobs.description:
Your Mission 
 With the power of AI, we're set to revolutionize the way general contractors and subcontractors find and match with each other on our marketplace. As our Senior Product Manager Marketplace, you'll actively shape this product vision — in a small team with big leverage and direct impact on a product used by thousands.
 
 Your Responsibilities 
 You own the marketplace dynamics between General contractors and Subcontractors on our platform.

 You ensure a healthy balance between supply and demand, and build mechanisms that keep liquidity strong on both sides.

 You own search, matching and recommendation mechanisms that bring Subcontractors and projects together in a way that increases relevance and bid rate.

 You analyze marketplace metrics and translate them into hypotheses and priorities.

 You identify AI use cases for matching and recommendations and implement them together with our designers and engineers.

 
 What You Bring 
 3–5 years of product management experience with two- or multi-sided marketplaces.

 Demonstrated experience thinking through supply-demand dynamics: how to create enough supply, enough demand, and how to balance the sometimes conflicting interests of both sides.

 Experience with search or matching algorithms, or working closely with data and engineering teams on ranking or recommendation logic.

 Strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of marketplace metrics such as liquidity, conversion, and network effects.

 You use AI tools such as LLM-based assistants, MCPs, and no-code prototyping routinely in your day-to-day work.

 Fluent in written and spoken German and English.

 
 Your Benefits 
 Help shape a product that solves real-world problems in the construction industry through AI and is revolutionizing the market.

 Work in an open-minded, dynamic, and international team.

 Remote or from our modern office in Berlin Friedrichshain.

 Regular company and team events (offline and online).

 Permanent contract and modern equipment.

 Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

 
 About us 
 Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.
 We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.
 
 Why Cosuno?
 Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.
 But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.
 Join us – Build the future of construction.

jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale.

Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. 

 Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. 

 At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. 
 You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. 
 

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
 Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
 Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.  
 

 What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible:  We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. 

 Room to grow // Stay curious:  In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. 

 Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active:  We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. 

 Taking responsibility // We #care:  We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Your mission

 As Senior Product Manager for Heating & Cooling, you own Heat as a product. What must be true in the household: space heating, hot water, and cooling people can trust, at a cost that makes sense, controlled with Heartbeat.

 You decide where Heating & Cooling goes next. Which problems we solve first. How hardware partners, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience add up to one result — in Germany and in the other markets we operate in. You own the problem, the requirements, and the outcomes.

 Your main focus will be to:

 
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Heating & Cooling: where the area goes, and how it evolves across markets

 Define the customer outcome (comfort, cost, control, reliability) and the KPIs that prove it

 Turn hardware and field constraints into product requirements. Cut work that does not serve the outcome.

 Drive thermal optimization on our Energy Management System

 Align hardware, the Energy Management System, and the customer experience so households get one heat and cooling experience

 Write specs, run discovery, prioritize, and ship

 
 Your profile

 You have:

 
 5+ years of Product Management on hardware-software products, energy, HVAC, or similarly physical systems

 A track record of owning a customer outcome across more than one engineering team

 Comfort at the seam of OEM interfaces, optimization, and customer UX

 Excellent English and German

 Based in Germany or willing to relocate

 
 Bonus points for:

 
 Heat pumps, SG Ready, EEBus, Modbus, OEM cloud APIs

 Field or installer experience

 Thermal optimization or HEMS with heat pumps

 Heating and cooling products across more than one country

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, B2B Trade Platform
jobs.description:
About Andercore 
 Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.
 We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.
 Where we are today:
 Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

 Seven European markets live

 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

 $40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.
 We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.
 
 About this role 
 We're hiring a Director Product Management to own a core product area end to end. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and ship it yourself, reporting directly to the founder. 
 
 What you will own 
 A P&L-relevant product area (logistics automation, pricing, or embedded finance) from discovery to shipped outcomes

 Concrete targets, not vibes: we run on automation and retention metrics, and your area will have a number attached

 Discovery with real users: traders, logistics operators, and buyers, weekly and in person 

 Prioritization and delivery with your engineering squad, including the calls on what not to build

 Post-launch iteration driven by usage data and margin impact, not opinion

 What you bring 
 5+ years in product management with at least 2 at a B2B scale-up, owning a product area through significant growth

 Shipped products in an operations-heavy domain: logistics, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech, or similar

 Fluency with data: you pull your own numbers, define your own metrics, and change course when they tell you to

 A track record of fast MVP cycles: built, measured, iterated or killed, and you can walk us through the decisions

 Experience shipping AI-powered features to production is a strong plus

 Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement

 What this role is not 

 Not a people-management role on day one. You'll lead through the product, with a path to building a team as the org scales.

 Not a strategy-deck job. If your best work lives in slides rather than shipped product, this isn't the fit.

You’ll be joining the Retail Categories team.   • Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact.

  • Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology

Location: London | Work model: Hybrid | Reports to: Senior Manager, People Product

About the team

People Technology builds and runs the systems behind every hire, transfer, leave, pay change and offboard for our workforce across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to make the operational backbone of People Operations invisible when it works — reliable, compliant, and scalable across dozens of markets — so our people teams can focus on people, not process. This role sits on the People Product team, working alongside Business Systems Analysts, engineers and delivery leadership to bring product thinking to one of our highest-volume, highest-consequence surfaces.

About the role

Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. Demand structurally exceeds capacity, and requests arrive from every direction without a shared shape. You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

  • Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

  • Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

  • Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work

  • Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead

  • Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)

  • Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date

  • Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

  • Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

  • Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

  • Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

  • Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions

  • Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
 Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

 Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
 Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
 Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
 Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
 Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
 Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
 Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
 Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
 Actively contributing to internal discussions.
 Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
 As Project Officer,  the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
 As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.
 

 We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
 As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
 As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years

jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

Über die Rolle

Du möchtest die Zukunft des Wohnens aktiv mitgestalten – mit Fokus auf die Umsetzung? Du möchtest ein Team bilden, das mit Spaß an der Arbeit eine gute Performance erreicht? Als Senior Projektleiter/in - Bau / Senior Project Manager (w/m/d) bei uns, einem innovativen Generalübernehmer im nachhaltigen Wohnbau, übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Bauprojekte von der Bauantragseinreichung bis zur schlüsselfertigen Übergabe an einen zufriedenen Kunden. Du bist dafür zuständig, dass unsere Wohnbauprojekte (ab 4.500 m2 BGF aufwärts) termin- und qualitätsgerecht realisiert werden und verantwortest dabei die Kosten und Zahlungsströme.  

Insbesondere werden deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Steuerung von Bauprojekten im Roh- und Schlüsselfertigbau unter Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen und technischen Zielsetzung
  • Termingerechte und qualitätssichere Umsetzung des vertraglichen Bau-Solls
  • Kontrolle des Bauablaufs und der Baustellenergebnisse
  • Koordinieren und überwachen der Einsätze von Fachingenieuren, Fachberater, Personal sowie Nachunternehmen
  • Führung und Organisation des Baustellenteams und Verantwortung über die Personaleinsatzplanung
  • Management von Kosten und Zahlungsströmen
  • Verhandlungsführung mit Auftraggebern und Nachunternehmen
  • Nachtragsgestaltung und -durchsetzung gegenüber den Auftraggebern 

Über dich

  • Einen Studienabschluss in der Fachrichtung Bauingenieurwesen oder Architektur bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation  
  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung beim Bau von Großprojekten, idealerweise bei einem GU oder GÜ  
  • Reisebereitschaft zu unseren Baustellen deutschlandweit - du trägst die Projektverantwortung und entscheidest selbst, wann deine  Anwesenheit vor Ort notwendig ist
  • Einen sicheren im Umgang mit Office Produkten (Excel, Word...) und gängigen Projekt Management Softwares
  • Erfahrung in der Ressourceneinsatzplanung, Lean Construction ist ein Plus
  • Einen transparenten und kooperativen Kommunikationsstil sowie ein starkes Verhandlungsgeschick und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Teamgeist und eine selbstständige sowie verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
  • Begeisterung für digitale Anwendungen und innovative Prozessgestaltung
  • Fließende Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse 

Was wir bieten

  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.
  • Virtuelles Aktienprogramm: Profitiere von GROPYUS Erfolg durch unser Virtuelles Aktienprogramm.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) AI Projects
jobs.description:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) AI Projects, who will coordinate the planning, delivery, and resourcing of AI and robotics projects across engineering, research, and operations teams.

Your Responsibilities

  • Project Delivery: Define objectives, plan, and schedule projects, owning task allocation, resourcing, and execution through to deployment across distributed stakeholder locations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Act as the interface between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, maintaining alignment on goals, milestones, and progress.
  • Team Coordination: Coordinate cross-functional project teams and facilitate Agile ceremonies such as Scrum and Kanban.
  • Risk Management: Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and resolve issues that threaten milestones or delivery commitments.
  • Hardware Procurement: Manage procurement of hardware and related equipment, coordinating with vendors and internal stakeholders on acquisition, delivery, and allocation within project budgets.
  • Process Improvement: Evaluate and refine project workflows and run post-project reviews to capture lessons learned.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in robotics, computer science, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience managing technical projects.
  • Project Management: Experience managing complex technical projects with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), preferably in automation or robotics environments.
  • Communication: Verbal and written communication that translates technical concepts for varied audiences.
  • Technical Grounding: Working understanding of robotic system components, including sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces.
  • Language: Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Beneficial Skills

  • Technical Tools: Experience with ROS, Python, and Linux-based environments.
  • Chinese Language: Proficiency in Chinese.
  • Travel Readiness: Willingness to travel to stakeholder and customer locations (25–40%), primarily in East Asia.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

 

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sex
